subject: Request: coverage addendum / bridge letter for SOC 2 (Novapulse integration)
messages:
From: Karim Hong <karim.hong@novapulse.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novapulse.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: coverage addendum for SOC 2 report (Novapulse integration)

Hi Grace,

We're in the final procurement stage for the Novapulse <> Redwood integration and our security team flagged a gap: the SOC 2 Type II report you previously shared covers period ending 2024-12-31. Our control baseline requires evidence covering through the contract effective date (targeting 2026-03-15).

Can Redwood provide either: (a) an updated SOC 2 report covering a later period, or (b) a bridge/coverage addendum (bridge letter) that explicitly confirms there have been no material control changes since the report end date and covers the period from 2025-01-01 through the present?

Specifically, please include:
- Statement of report end date and exact period the bridge letter covers
- Confirmation about changes to control environment (major vendors, control owners, scope changes)
- Any exceptions, incidents, or investigations since 2024-12-31

We also have the SIG questionnaire in flight; if you prefer us to accept a bridge letter plus completed SIG subset, that may be sufficient for the procurement team. Our procurement target is to complete contract signing by 2026-03-12, so a response early next week would be ideal.

Thanks,
Karim Hong
Director, Security & Compliance
Novapulse Inc.

--
Novapulse Procurement: procurement@novapulse.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karim Hong <karim.hong@novapulse.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: coverage addendum for SOC 2 report (Novapulse integration)

Hi Karim,

Thanks for flagging this — appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. We're happy to support Novapulse's procurement process.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide a bridge/coverage addendum that states the SOC 2 Type II report that we issued (report period ending 2024-12-31) remains representative and that there have been no material control changes impacting the in-scope systems since that date.
- I'll attach the most recent SOC 2 Type II report we have for reference.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will bring in our security & legal team to draft a bridge letter tailored to the period you need (we can cover 2025-01-01 through the requested date).
2) Please confirm the exact coverage end date you need (you mentioned 2026-03-15 as contract effective date — do you need coverage through that date or through the signing date?).
3) If Novapulse has a SIG/CAIQ subset you'd like us to answer, send that along and we'll prioritize the sections related to infrastructure, access control, and incident response.

Attached: redwood_soc2-type2_2024-12-31.pdf (for your records).

I'll loop in Dev (security ops) and Evelyn (legal/compliance) to coordinate the draft and target turnaround.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_soc2-type2_2024-12-31.pdf
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karim Hong <karim.hong@novapulse.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Draft: coverage addendum (bridge letter) for Novapulse

Hi Karim / Grace,

Following up from Grace's note — attached is a draft bridge letter for Novapulse that covers the period 2025-01-01 through 2026-03-05 (we can adjust the end date if you need coverage through signing on 2026-03-15). The draft includes:
- Date-stamped assertion referencing our SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2024-12-31)
- Explicit statement that there have been no material changes to controls in scope for Redwood Inference's hosted inference platform since 2024-12-31
- Callouts for a small list of vendor onboarding activities (third-party logging vendor added June 2025) that did not impact control effectiveness; those items are documented in the appendix.
- Signature block for our VP of Security and our Legal counsel (we will execute via DocuSign once language is agreed).

Attached: redwood-bridge-letter-draft-20260225.docx

A couple of notes on timing and approvals:
- Legal and our external auditor prefer language that avoids absolute guarantees; we use "no material changes that would reasonably be expected to affect the control objectives covered in the report."
- If Novapulse requires a stronger statement or auditor attestation, that may require additional review and could take longer (we should understand that now).

If that language looks good to you, reply with "Approve draft" and we'll route to legal for final sign-off and send for signature. We're aiming to get a signed PDF back to you by 2026-03-05 if we receive approval this week.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-bridge-letter-draft-20260225.docx

- We prefer language that covers the signing date (so coverage through 2026-03-15). Can you adjust the end date accordingly?
